profile.name: Monid
profile.description: Monid is a San Francisco‑based platform that lets AI agents instantly access over 1,700 tools and APIs through a single integration. By adding one skill file, an agent can discover, compare, and invoke the most suitable service at runtime without individual sign‑ups or subscription plans. Monid handles tool selection, pricing, and metering, charging only per call from a unified balance. The catalog spans AI generation, web scraping, weather, finance, 3D modeling, and more, supporting popular agent frameworks via skill files, remote MCP servers, or a CLI. Developers can also list their own APIs on Monid to receive routed traffic and revenue sharing. The result is a frictionless, on‑demand toolbox that empowers agents to perform complex tasks with minimal setup.
profile.slogan: One skill unlocks 1,800+ tools & APIs for your agent.

briefing.summary: One vertical face-to-camera video, about 30 to 40 seconds, in a smug founder-confession tone. You tell the story: you gave an agent $3 and one skill file, it found tools nobody signed up for, and the charge was a fraction of a cent. Film it in the green-screen-in-front-of-a-chalkboard style from the reference. Cut to real screen recordings of the Monid run as proof. Use your normal voice, the same dry, slightly panicked-about-API-bills energy as your openai bill video.
briefing.hook: Open on you, close to camera, smug, saying: "We gave an agent three dollars and one skill file, and we saw, wow," with "WE GAVE IT $3" as the first caption. Pause one beat on "wow" before the cut.
talking_points: Setup is one line: paste `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md` into your agent. It installs the skill and knows how to use Monid. (It also works as an MCP server or a CLI, but only mention that if it fits. The video is about the one line.)
Give the agent a real task. Use: "compare openai vs anthropic: positioning, pricing, traction".
The agent calls monid.discover() and gets 12 candidate tools ranked by fit and price.
It then calls monid.run() on one of them right away, with no sign-up and no API key for that provider.
The balance ticks down. The example charge is $0.0013 from a $3.000 balance, so about a tenth of a cent. Say it as "about a tenth of a cent, and so this was worth it."
Pay per call from one balance, no subscriptions. Land on: "We killed the subscriptions."
Close with the name, "Monid dot ai," and the CTA: paste `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md` into your agent and take the $1 free credit.

Script to follow (one-to-one remake, light rewording to sound like you is fine): "We gave an agent three dollars and one skill file, and we saw, wow, it found twelve tools ranked by fit and price. It ran one with no sign-up. The charge was about a tenth of a cent, and so this was worth it. We killed the subscriptions. This was successful. Monid dot ai."

4-10s: Cut to a screen recording of the terminal or agent chat with `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md` and the task prompt. Shrink yourself to a corner and keep reacting while it plays, like the reference.
10-17s: Cut to the real monid.discover() output showing 12 candidates ranked by fit and price. Put yourself back in frame, pointing at it, for "it found twelve tools ranked by fit and price."
17-23s: Cut to monid.run() returning results from a tool you never signed up for. Say "It ran one with no sign-up."
23-30s: Cut to the balance readout and the per-call debit. The example is $3.000 balance and a $0.0013 charge. Zoom or circle the charge. Deliver "about a tenth of a cent" deadpan.

30-35s: Quick cut to the homepage tool grid (Apollo, Ahrefs, Exa, Firecrawl, ElevenLabs and others) as you say "We killed the subscriptions." Then back to you, smug, for "This was successful. Monid dot ai."

35-40s: End on a short Mario-level meme gag, as the reference does. For example, cut to a Mario flagpole finish as you walk off, with the CTA caption: paste `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md`, $1 free credit. No music, as in the reference.
Move around the frame between cuts and cut every 3 to 7 seconds. Keep captions bold and word-by-word throughout.
deliverables: One vertical video (9:16), about 30-40 seconds, posted to your TikTok, face-to-camera in the reference format
Raw clip files and the screen recordings you used, so the brand can reuse them on its own accounts
Caption copy for the post that includes the setup line and the $1 free credit
dos: Run the real thing yourself and screen-record it. Use the actual discover() and run() output and the actual balance readout.
If your numbers differ from the example ($3 balance, 12 candidates, $0.0013 charge), change the spoken line to match what's on screen.
Keep sentences short and plain. Smug, not salesy.
Say the setup line out loud and show it on screen so people can copy it.
State the offer exactly: $1 in free credit, pay per call from one balance, no subscriptions.
Disclose the partnership per TikTok's rules.
donts: Don't claim anything not in the brief: no spend caps or limits, no uptime or speed promises, no comparisons to named competitors.
Don't say the agent never picks wrong or can't run up charges. Stick to what you showed.

briefing.title: We gave an agent $3 and one skill file
briefing.summary: One vertical face-to-camera video, about 30 to 40 seconds, in a smug founder-confession tone. You tell the story: you gave an agent $3 and one skill file, it found tools nobody signed up for, and the charge was a fraction of a cent. Film it in the green-screen-in-front-of-a-chalkboard style from the reference. Cut to real screen recordings of the Monid run as proof. Use your normal voice, the same dry, slightly panicked-about-API-bills energy as your openai bill video.
briefing.hook: Open on you, close to camera, smug, saying: "We gave an agent three dollars and one skill file, and we saw, wow," with "WE GAVE IT $3" as the first caption. Pause one beat on "wow" before the cut.
talking_points: Setup is one line: paste `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md` into your agent. It installs the skill and knows how to use Monid. (It also works as an MCP server or a CLI, but only mention that if it fits. The video is about the one line.)
Give the agent a real task. Use: "compare openai vs anthropic: positioning, pricing, traction".
